intro.title: Sa7ne is pronounced Sahne
intro.p1: Every home has a way of speaking. The way a table is set, the colours chosen, the pieces displayed — these are not decoration. They are a declaration. Sa7ne was born from the belief that the dinner table is one of the most intimate experiences of a home. Sa7ne carries the personality of it's owner.
intro.p2: Sa7ne — صَحْني, meaning "my plate" in Arabic — is a ceramics studio dedicated to personalising the act of hosting.
intro.p3: A Sa7ne table is a story of you.

header.title: Your Table Tells Your Story
header.subtitle: Sa7ne is not just dinnerware. It is your vocabulary displayed in handcrafted form. Each piece is personalised, and entirely yours.

personality.image_alt: Conversationalist collection — plates with Khaleeji phrases
personality.title: Your Colour. Your Words. Your Table.
personality.p1: Color is the first language of a tablescape. It sets the mood before a single dish is served. At Sa7ne, color is never incidental — it is the starting point of every piece we make. From the deep blush of our speckled bowls to the warm honey wash of a glazed platter, each hue is chosen to sit within a considered palette that reflects how the homeowner sees and inhabits their space.
personality.p2: But color alone is not enough. Sa7ne also speaks in words. Our Conversationalist Collection carries the phrases your table would say if it could speak — Khaleeji expressions, terms of endearment, questions that make guests laugh. Our blessing plates carry Arabic words of gratitude and abundance. Every piece is a piece of language, hand-painted and fired into permanence.
personality.p3: This is what it means for a table to have a personality: not that it is decorated, but that it communicates. Sa7ne helps you find what your table wants to say.

moodboard.title: See Your Tablescape Before It Exists
moodboard.p1: One of the most common challenges homeowners face is not knowing how to begin. Which pieces work together? How do the colors relate? What does the finished table actually look like? Sa7ne answers this through a moodboard service — a visual composition of Sa7ne pieces styled within a tablescape, so you can see your home's story told before a single piece is made.
moodboard.p2: Tell us about your home, your palette, your occasions, and the feeling you want your table to give — and we will compose a bespoke moodboard that maps out your Sa7ne collection. Think of it as interior direction for your dining room: a visual language for how your pieces might live together, season to season, gathering to gathering.
moodboard.p3: Because a beautiful table is not assembled — it is curated. And curation begins with a vision.

cta.title: What Does Your Table Want to Say?
cta.subtitle: Start with a custom order or a moodboard consultation — and let Sa7ne help you find the visual language of your home.

philosophy.title: Hosting Is Storytelling
philosophy.p1: There is a particular kind of host whose table you remember long after the evening ends. It is not the food alone — it is the feeling of intention. The sense that every object was chosen, that the colors speak to each other, that the table itself has a voice. Sa7ne exists to give that voice a form.
philosophy.p2: We think of each collection as a chapter in the homeowner's story. The blush speckled bowl that always holds the season's fruit. The honey-glazed platter that appears at every gathering. The cake stand painted with stars and the Arabic word for sustenance — رزق — set out on the night of a celebration. These pieces are not interchangeable. They belong to a specific home, a specific host, a specific way of being in the world.
philosophy.p3: Sa7ne captures the personality and vocabulary of the dinner host and hostess — their colour sensibility, their warmth, their humour, their heritage — and translates it into ceramic form. A table set with Sa7ne pieces is a table that could only belong to you.
